parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is the main upper part made of durable plastic, typically enclosing the internal metal mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main housing and pressing component that drives the staple through paper when pressed down.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around a hinge at the rear, moving downward to press staples into paper.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a metallic cover part of the stapler, often attached to the body to hold and guide the staples.
parts.Functional_description: It helps secure the staple magazine and provides structural rigidity to the stapler’s pressing mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly with the body during operation but remains mostly fixed relative to the hinge.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the bottom part of the stapler, made of plastic, providing stability and support during use.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the anvil plate where staples are bent and secures the stapler on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, providing a stable platform for the stapling action.
